messages:
alice: planning a staggered bump for feature_x toggle tonight — target move from 10% -> 40% in three steps. proposing 22:00 UTC start, then +15m -> 30% at 22:15, final 40% at 22:30. who can own the flips and smoke checks?
ben: I can flip and watch the first two steps. putting it on my calendar. will be online for the whole 45m.
cara: I'll run the smoke checklist after each step (latency, 5xx rate, token cost spike). checklist: 1) confirm p50/p95 within baseline, 2) errors <0.1%, 3) no sudden queue growth.
alice: thanks — can you paste the quick queries you run so ben has them?
cara: sure — run these in grafana quick panel: `service:inference_errors{flag:feature_x}`, `latency.p95{route:generate}`, `queue.depth{pool:shared}`. quick curl to check rollout percent: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/internals/flags/feature_x`
devops-bot: scheduled: feature_x-bump-job at 2026-11-03T22:00:00Z (owner: ben). reminders at -10m and -1m.
dave: rollback plan — we toggle back to 10% with the same API. command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/flags/feature_x -H 'Authorization: Bearer $K' -d '{"percent":10}'
``` also have a pre-made k8s job to drain one pool if we see mem pressure.
eva: quick note on canary routing — if errors spike, traffic will route to fallback model automatically (policy: fallback-lower-tier). alert will page on >=3 minute sustained 5xx above 0.5%. I set threshold in alerting.
ben: plan: flip to 20% at 22:00, confirm checks by 22:10, flip to 30% at 22:15, final to 40% at 22:30. I'll post status after each step like `step1 ok` or `rollback started`.
cara: I'll post smoke summaries, short lines only. sample: `step1: p95 +8ms (ok), 5xx 0.02% (ok)`, `step2: p95 +12ms (watch)`, etc.
alice: owners: ben flips, cara smoke, dave on rollback standby, eva monitoring alerts. can everyone react with :thumbsup: if ok?
ben: :+1:
cara: :thumbsup:
dave: :ok_hand:
eva: :thumbsup:
alice: cool — ben I'll DM the exact API key for the curl command before start. we want minimum chatter in channel during flips; only post problems or final OKs.
ben: noted. will post `step1 ok` / `step2 ok` / `final ok` or `rollback started`.
devops-bot: reminder posting 10 minutes before bump.
cara: one more ask — if any anomaly, capture a short trie of the request sample and paste in thread: `curl https://traces.redwood/trace/<id>` so we can triage quickly.
alice: perfect. see you all at 22:00 UTC. thanks!
